'''KashyCorp''' was an innovative shipwright based out of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], KashyCorp produced the [[Owool Interceptor]]. The Owool was originally designed for the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] but was quickly turned against them when [[Darth Caedus]] ordered the [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of Kashyyyk.
